Support that goes beyond completing tasks.

I am an administrative and customer support professional with over 8 years of experience in customer service, healthcare support, technical assistance, account management, and team leadership.

Today, I bring that experience into remote business operations, helping business owners stay organized, improve team coordination, and focus on their priorities.

Effective remote support requires ownership, consistency, communication, and the ability to anticipate operational needs.

My goal is to become a reliable point of contact between business owners, their teams, and daily operations. That means I aim to:

  • Reduce the CEO’s daily administrative workload.
  • Minimize the time spent monitoring and following up with team members.
  • Improve communication and coordination across remote teams.
  • Ensure tasks, deadlines, and priorities are consistently monitored.
  • Reduce operational bottlenecks and missed follow-ups.
  • Provide clear updates on team productivity and daily operations.
  • Give business owners more time for strategy, decision-making, and growth.
